raw_problem.problem_text:
$$
\frac {\Delta E}{E} = A \left(b / a\right) ^ {n}.
$$

确定常数 $A$ 和罪指数 $n$ 的值.最后，将 $b \approx 1 0 ^ { - 1 5 } \mathrm { ~ m ~ }$ (大约为质子的半径)代入计算出实际数值.它与精细结构和超精细结构相比如何?
raw_problem.solution_text:
根据题意，当 $r < b$ 时，电子的哈密顿量为

$$
H = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} b}, \quad 0 <   r <   b,
$$

该哈密顿量可以写为

$$
H = H _ {0} + H ^ {\prime} = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} r} - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left(\frac {1}{b} - \frac {1}{r}\right), 0 <   r <   b.
$$

所以微扰哈密顿量为

$$
H ^ {\prime} = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \left(\frac {1}{b} - \frac {1}{r}\right).
$$

氢原子基础函数为 $\psi _ { 1 0 0 } = \frac { 1 } { \sqrt { \pi a ^ { 3 } } } \mathrm { e } ^ { - r / a }$ ，所以能量的一阶修正为vπa‘'

$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta E = \langle \psi_ {1 0 0} | H ^ {\prime} | \psi_ {1 0 0} \rangle = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{\pi a ^ {3}} \int \left(\frac {1}{b} - \frac {1}{r}\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} r ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi \mathrm {d} r \\ = - \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{\pi a ^ {3}} 4 \pi \int_ {0} ^ {b} \left(\frac {r ^ {2}}{b} - r\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \mathrm {d} r. \\ \end{array}
$$

积分，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {b} r ^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \mathrm {d} r = - \frac {a b ^ {2}}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} - \frac {a ^ {2} b}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} - \frac {a ^ {3}}{4} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} + \frac {a ^ {3}}{4}, \\ \int_ {0} ^ {b} r \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \mathrm {d} r = - \frac {a b}{2} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{4} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} + \frac {a ^ {2}}{4}, \\ \end{array}
$$

得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \int_ {0} ^ {b} \left(\frac {r ^ {2}}{b} - r\right) \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 r / a} \mathrm {d} r = - \frac {a ^ {2}}{4} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} - \frac {a ^ {3}}{4 b} \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} + \frac {a ^ {3}}{4 b} - \frac {a ^ {2}}{4} \\ = - \frac {1}{4} a ^ {2} \left[ \left(1 - \frac {a}{b}\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} \left(1 + \frac {a}{b}\right) \right], \\ \end{array}
$$

故

$$
\Delta E = \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} a} \left[ \left(1 - \frac {a}{b}\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {- 2 b / a} \left(1 + \frac {a}{b}\right) \right].
$$

由于 $a \sim 1 0 ^ { - 1 1 } ~ \mathrm { m } , b \sim 1 0 ^ { - 1 5 } ~ \mathrm { m } .$ ，所以 $b / a \ll 1$ .设 $\varepsilon = 2 b / a$ ，则能量修正可以表示为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \Delta E = \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} a} \left[ \left(1 - \frac {2}{\varepsilon}\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \varepsilon} \left(1 + \frac {2}{\varepsilon}\right) \right] \\ = \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} a} \left[ \left(1 - \frac {2}{\varepsilon}\right) + \left(1 - \varepsilon + \frac {1}{2} \varepsilon^ {2} - \frac {1}{6} \varepsilon^ {3} + \dots\right) \left(1 + \frac {2}{\varepsilon}\right) \right] \\ = \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} a} \left(\frac {1}{6} \varepsilon^ {2} + \dots\right) \\ \approx \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} a} \frac {4}{6} \frac {b ^ {2}}{a ^ {2}} \\ \approx \frac {e ^ {2} b ^ {2}}{6 \pi \varepsilon_ {0} a ^ {3}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

$E _ { 1 } = - \frac { e ^ { 2 } } { 8 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } a }$ 2由于 所以自:n:éoa'

$$
\frac {\Delta E}{E _ {1}} = - \frac {4}{3} \left(\frac {b}{a}\right) ^ {2} = - \frac {4}{3} \left(\frac {1 0 ^ {- 1 5}}{5 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 1}}\right) ^ {2} \approx - 5 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 0}.
$$

对于精细结构，有 ${ \frac { \Delta E } { E } } \approx \alpha ^ { 2 } \approx \left( { \frac { 1 } { 1 3 7 } } \right) ^ { 2 } \sim 1 0 ^ { - 5 }$ 局 α2 _._~~._...._ ~-... 对于超精细结构，有，-...---~..，.. ${ \frac { \Delta E } { E } } \approx \left( { \frac { m _ { \mathrm { e } } } { m _ { \mathrm { p } } } } \right) \alpha ^ { 2 } \sim 1 0 ^ { - 8 }$ ，所mp}以考虑核子有限半径的能量修正要比精细结构和超精细结构能量修正小得多.

习题 在本题中，将发展另外一种简并微扰理论方法.考虑无微扰哈密顿量$H ^ { 0 }$ 具有两个简并态 $\psi _ { a } ^ { 0 }$ 和 $\psi _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ (能量 $E _ { 0 }$ 微扰为 $H ^ { \prime }$ 定义投影①到简并子空间的算符为

$$
P _ {D} = \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|.
$$

哈密顿量可以写成

$$
H = H ^ {0} + H ^ {\prime} = \tilde {H} ^ {0} + \tilde {H} ^ {\prime},
$$

其中

$$
\tilde {H} ^ {0} = H ^ {0} + P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D}, \quad \tilde {H} ^ {\prime} = H ^ {\prime} - P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D}.
$$

假设 ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { 0 }$ 为"无微扰"哈密顿量 ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { \prime }$ 为微扰;很快就会发现， ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { 0 }$ 是非简井的，所以可以利用一般的非简并微扰理论来处理.

(a) 首先需要求出 ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { 0 }$ 的本征态.

(i) 证明: $H ^ { 0 }$ 的任何一个本征态 $\psi _ { n } ^ { 0 }$ （除 $\psi _ { a } ^ { 0 }$ 和 $\psi _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ 以外)也是 ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { 0 }$ 的本征态，且本征值相同.  
(ii) 证明: "好"态 $\psi ^ { 0 } = \alpha \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } + \beta \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ 是 ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { 0 }$ 口的本征态 $\overset { \cdot } { \alpha }$ 和 $\beta$ 由方程 (7.30)定)，能量为 $E ^ { 0 } + E _ { \pm } ^ { 1 }$ .  
(b) 假设 $E _ { + } ^ { 1 }$ 和 $E _ { - } ^ { 1 }$ 不同，现在存在一个非简井的无微扰哈密顿量 ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { 0 }$ ，你可以将 ${ \tilde { H } } ^ { \prime }$ 作为微扰利用非简并微扰理论.对在 (ii) 中的态 $\psi _ { \pm } ^ { 0 }$ ，求出能量二阶修正的表达式.

注释这种方法的一个优点是，它还可以处理无微扰能量不完全相等的体系，但非常接近的情况 ${ } ^ { \textregistered } E _ { a } ^ { 0 } \approx E _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ 在该情况下，还必须使用简井微扰理论;一个重要的例子是计算近自由电子近似的能带结构

解答 (a)

(i)

$$
\begin{array}{l} \tilde {H} ^ {0} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle = H ^ {0} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle + P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = H ^ {0} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle + \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) H ^ {\prime} \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = E _ {n} ^ {0} \left| \right. \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \left. \right\rangle + \left( \right.\left| \right. \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \left. \right\rangle\left\langle \right. \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \left. \right| + \left| \right. \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \left. \right\rangle\left\langle \right. \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \left. \right|\left. \right) H ^ {\prime} \left( \right.\left| \right. \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \left. \right\rangle\left\langle \right. \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \left. \right| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \left. \right\rangle + \left| \right. \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \left. \right\rangle\left\langle \right. \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \mid \psi_ {n} ^ {0}\left. \right)\left. \right) \\ = E _ {n} ^ {0} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right > . \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
H ^ {0} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle = E _ {n} ^ {0} \left| \psi_ {n} ^ {0} \right\rangle .
$$

因此 $H ^ { 0 }$ 口的任何一个本征态 $\psi _ { n } ^ { 0 }$ (而不 $\psi _ { a } ^ { 0 }$ 或 $\psi _ { b } ^ { 0 }$ ) 同样也是具有相同本征值的 $\tilde { H } ^ { 0 }$ 的一个本征态.(ii)

$$
\begin{array}{l} \tilde {H} ^ {0} \psi_ {n} ^ {0} = \left(H ^ {0} + P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D}\right) \left(\alpha \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle + \beta \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle\right) \\ = \alpha H ^ {0} | \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \rangle + \beta H ^ {0} | \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \rangle + \alpha P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D} | \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \rangle + \beta P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D} | \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \rangle \\ = \alpha E ^ {0} \psi_ {a} ^ {0} + \beta E ^ {0} \psi_ {b} ^ {0} + \alpha \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) H ^ {\prime} \\ \times \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ + \beta \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) H ^ {\prime} \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = \alpha E ^ {0} \psi_ {a} ^ {0} + \beta E ^ {0} \psi_ {b} ^ {0} + \alpha \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ + \beta \left(\left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right| + \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \left\langle \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right|\right) H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} = \alpha E ^ {0} | \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \rangle + \beta E ^ {0} | \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \rangle + \alpha \left(W _ {a a} | \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \rangle + W _ {b a} | \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \rangle\right) \\ + \beta \left(W _ {a b} \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle + W _ {b b} \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle\right), \\ \end{array}
$$

其中 $W _ { a a } = \left. \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right. H ^ { \prime } \left. \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right. , W _ { a b } = W _ { b a } ^ { \ast } = \left. \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right. H ^ { \prime } \left. \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right. , W _ { b b } = \left. \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 } \right. H ^ { \prime } \left. \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 } \right.$ ;上式可继续写为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left(\alpha E ^ {0} + \alpha E ^ {0} W _ {a a} + \beta W _ {a b}\right) \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle + \left(\beta E ^ {0} + \alpha W _ {b a} + \beta W _ {b b}\right) \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = \left(\alpha E ^ {0} + \alpha E ^ {1}\right) \left| \psi_ {a} ^ {0} \right\rangle + \left(\beta E ^ {0} + \beta E ^ {1}\right) \left| \psi_ {b} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = \left(E ^ {0} + E ^ {1}\right) \left(\alpha \left| \psi_ {\alpha} ^ {0} \right\rangle + \beta \left| \psi_ {\beta} ^ {0} \right\rangle\right) \\ = \left(E ^ {0} + E ^ {1}\right) | \psi^ {0} \rangle , \\ \end{array}
$$

其中 $E ^ { 1 }$ 来自于方程 (7.27) (7.29) ，即

$$
\alpha W _ {a a} + \beta W _ {a b} = \alpha E ^ {1}, \quad \alpha W _ {b a} + \beta W _ {b b} = \beta E ^ {1}.
$$

(b) 利用非简并微扰理论对 $\psi _ { + }$ 能量的二阶修正为

$$
E _ {+} = \left(E ^ {0} + E _ {+} ^ {1}\right) + \left\langle \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right| \tilde {H} ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle + \sum_ {m \neq +} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| \tilde {H} ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E ^ {0} + E _ {+} ^ {1} - E _ {m} ^ {0}}.
$$

由于 $\left| \psi _ { + } ^ { 0 } \right.$ 为 $\left| \psi _ { a } ^ { 0 } \right.$ 和 $\left| \psi _ { b } ^ { 0 } \right.$ 的结性组合，所以 $P _ { D } \left| \psi _ { + } ^ { 0 } \right. = \left| \psi _ { + } ^ { 0 } \right.$ 和 $\left. \psi _ { + } ^ { 0 } \right| { \cal P } _ { D } = \left. \psi _ { + } ^ { 0 } \right|$ 因此，

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right| \tilde {H} ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left\langle \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle - \left\langle \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right| P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = \left\langle \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle - \left\langle \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

又因为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| \tilde {H} ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle = \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle - \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle - \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle \\ = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {+} ^ {0} \right\rangle , & (m \neq \pm) \\ 0, & (m = \pm) \end{array} \right. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以

$$
E _ {\pm} = E ^ {0} + E _ {\pm} ^ {1} + \sum_ {m \neq \pm} \frac {\left| \left\langle \psi_ {m} ^ {0} \right| H ^ {\prime} \left| \psi_ {\pm} ^ {0} \right\rangle \right| ^ {2}}{E ^ {0} + E _ {\pm} ^ {1} - E _ {m} ^ {0}}.
$$

\tilde {H} ^ {0} = H ^ {0} + P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D}, \quad \tilde {H} ^ {\prime} = H ^ {\prime} - P _ {D} H ^ {\prime} P _ {D}.
